title: Development and Testing of VLT/ELT Dataflow Software and ALMA Dataflow Software
description: Division: DOO. Preliminary Inquiry followed by a Call for Tender: Preliminary Inquiry (PI) to identify and select companies that are interested in and capable of providing software development services for the development of front-end and back-end scientific operation dataflow software for the ESO observatories. The PI will be released in Q4/2022 to potential suppliers in the ESO Member States and will be followed by a Call for tender planned to be issued at the end of Q4/2022. The Call for Tender (CfT) will cover software development and testing services of operational dataflow software applications for ESO VLT/ELT/ALMA Observatories. Service Contract: The contract will start on 1 January 2024 (with a phase-in period as of 2023 Q4), for a firm period of 3 years, with the option to extend it by up to 2 more years. The CFT is scheduled to be issued in Q4/2022 to companies in the ESO Member States. Scope: The scope of work includes the development of front-end and back-end scientific operation dataflow software for the ESO observatories. It covers design, implementation, and testing of operational dataflow software applications for ESO VLT/ELT/ALMA Observatories. The contract will be structured around clearly defined deliverables using an agile process with roughly one to two months iteration cycles. At the end of each cycle the product for the next cycle will be agreed. The technical focus of this contract is on developing and testing REST and GraphQL APIs in Java with a database backend (both SQL and noSQL) and web interfaces in Angular/TypeScript. The contractor should have as a minimum the following experience/capabilities: · Proven professional experience developing software in Java. · Proven experience interfacing Java to relational databases (JDBC, JPA, Spring). · Proven experience developing Java web applications. · Proven experience with software architecture and API specification · Proven experience with RESTful and GraphQL API development. · Proven experience with test automation of APIs and web user interfaces. · Proven experience with Angular JS. · Familiarity with Agile software development process. · Solid practical familiarity with modern software engineering practices and tools, including configuration control tools, incremental & iterative development, unit and integration testing and the Linux environment. · Experience in the development and maintenance of software products in the science domain will be an asset. · The company shall use the development infrastructure to be provided by ESO (for version control, issue management, etc..). · The software shall be developed in a continuous integration system provided by ESO, building a running demonstration of the application. The contract is expected to be awarded in Q2/2023, to the Bidder, which has submitted a fully compliant Tender and offers the best value for money for ESO taking into account the quality and price of the offer.
